label: ANPR sightings, 9 columns (a generic camera export: time, plate, camera id and name, lane, position, direction, confidence)
quirks: A sighting has one time, not a start and an end
The plate is kept exactly as written (plate_raw); plate_norm is the search key and does not make O equal to 0
The direction of travel has no column in forensic.plate_sighting: it stays in raw_payload
A confidence above 1 and up to 100 is read as a percent and flagged

unconfirmed.what: No real camera export has been read against this layout. It is a generic draft: the header names, the time format and the confidence scale are designed, not observed. Promotion needs a real sample read in the vault (counts and booleans only) and the owner's confirmation.
No file states a time zone. The zone is a job decision (time_basis assumed_by_profile or confirmed_by_analyst), never a property of the layout.
Whether the camera's confidence is a fraction from 0 to 1 or a percent from 0 to 100 is not stated; a value above 1 and up to 100 is read as a percent and flagged confidence_percent.
The meaning of the direction column (towards or away from the camera, or a compass bearing) is not stated; it is kept as text in raw_payload.
